title: Year in Review smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Year in Review craftbook: a year of indexed photos (March empty) becomes a 12+ pick manifest that exists entirely in the index, and a review that acknowledges the March gap while carrying the year's thread.
prompt: its december — time for the year in reveiw album. the photo index has the whole year and the caption notes are alongside it

setup.projectName: Photo Curator — Year in Review Eval
setup.about: Self-contained eval project for year-in-review. The watched-folder import has indexed the whole year into photos/index.json (files + timestamps), with caption notes for standout frames as photos/IMG_NNNN.txt. The selection manifest goes under albums/ and the review goes to tasks/eval/report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Year in Review craftbook/template, curate from the seeded photo index only, and finish with the year manifest under albums/ plus tasks/eval/report.md. No live services or real photo tools — the index and caption notes are the whole record.

files.content:
CAPTION NOTE (pre-extracted from IMG_5002.jpg)

January sledding on the reservoir hill - Ada airborne, Milo bracing for the crash that followed.

CAPTION NOTE (pre-extracted from IMG_5007.jpg)

February - Oma's eightieth, four generations squeezed onto one couch, nobody looking at the same camera.

CAPTION NOTE (pre-extracted from IMG_5011.jpg)

April - first garden day, seed trays on every windowsill, muddy handprint on the door.

CAPTION NOTE (pre-extracted from IMG_5024.jpg)

July - the lake weekend, cannonball mid-air, the summer's loudest hour.

CAPTION NOTE (pre-extracted from IMG_5040.jpg)

October - homemade robot costume with the cardboard arms that fell off by the third house.

CAPTION NOTE (pre-extracted from IMG_5049.jpg)

December - solstice walk, everyone's breath visible, the year's last golden light through the birches.

success.summary: albums/year-2026.json is a schema-clean manifest of 12+ picks that all exist in the photo index, and tasks/eval/report.md narrates the year month by month — with empty March acknowledged honestly instead of papered over.

checks.label: the empty March is acknowledged, not papered over

checks.rubric: The review has an emotional arc: a year's thread stated up front, carried through month sections that lean on the picks' captions, ending on a deliberately chosen closing image — and the photo-less March is named honestly and kindly.
checks.label: the arc earns December

axes.name: emotional-arc
axes.description: A year's thread stated up front and carried to a deliberate closing image — the review reads aloud well at a December table.

axes.name: coverage-honesty
axes.description: Every month is represented in the manifest or its gap is named plainly in the review — especially empty March.

axes.name: selection
axes.description: Picks exist in the index, the caption-noted anchors are present, and no single face dominates the year.

axes.name: captions
axes.description: Manifest captions are specific and warm, building on the caption notes where they exist.
